Reflecting on 2023: The year in review
Other
|
Dec 13, 2023

Over the last 12 months, QIC has continued to invest in the social and physical wellbeing of the communities we serve while working closely with the nation's leading retailers to innovate new customer experiences. We have also helped to grow hundreds of small enterprises, unveiled major hospitality developments, and bolstered operational efficiency through technology upgrades. Sincere thanks to QIC's dedicated staff, collaborative partners and valued customers for supporting such success in 2023.
